subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should lease-bound external session orchestration be an Agentic OS-owned plugin/integration, or should core first expose a generic owner-neutral lease-backed spawn seam?
rationale: The branch creates a durable public Gateway and state contract whose owner, naming, and long-term compatibility policy cannot be selected safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Create a generic core seam
options.body: Approve a narrowly scoped, owner-neutral core capability and move Agentic OS policy, method names, and lifecycle semantics to the integration owner.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Close or rework this branch as an external plugin or adapter that uses current supported Gateway and plugin seams.

options.title: Adopt the named core contract
options.body: Explicitly accept Agentic OS-specific RPC and persisted-state ownership in core, with a documented compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Create a generic core seam
recommendation.body: Approve a narrowly scoped, owner-neutral core capability and move Agentic OS policy, method names, and lifecycle semantics to the integration owner.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available domain contact for the paired Agentic OS contract and downstream validation, while a core owner should make the final boundary decision.
